description: Search DeFi Garden's railed pool list by token symbol, chain, project, and minimum TVL floor. Excludes anomalous rates (>1000% APY) and pools below $100K TVL. Data is a daily snapshot of DefiLlama's pool feed.

chain.description: Case-insensitive match against pool blockchain, e.g. 'Base', 'Ethereum'

min_tvl.description: Minimum TVL floor in USD (clamps up to $100,000 minimum)

project.description: Case-insensitive match against protocol name, e.g. 'morpho-blue', 'aave-v3'

token.description: Case-insensitive substring match against pool token symbol, e.g. 'USDC'

name: find_pools
